subject: gk
question:
Which of the following statements is/are INCORRECT?

i. The 'SGSY' scheme was implemented in 2009.

ii. The primary objective of the 'SGSY' scheme was to promote and attain self employment.

iii. The 'SGSY' scheme performed well in Andhra Pradesh.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 4**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Swarnjayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana (SGSY)** was launched in **1999**, not 2009, making statement i incorrect.
 
• The primary objective of SGSY was to promote **self-employment** by organizing rural poor into Self-Help Groups (SHGs), making statement ii correct.
 
• SGSY showed significant success in states like Andhra Pradesh due to effective implementation, making statement iii correct.
 
• Since statement i is the only incorrect one, the correct option is **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Swarnjayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana (SGSY)**:

 
 
• SGSY was introduced in **1999** as a holistic program for poverty alleviation.
 
• It aimed at promoting self-employment by organizing rural poor into **Self-Help Groups (SHGs)**.
 
• The scheme focused on **skill development, infrastructure creation, and bank linkage.**
 
• It was later restructured into the **National Rural Livelihood Mission (NRLM)** in 2011.
 
 
 
• **Self-Help Groups (SHGs)**:
 
 
• SHGs are small groups of individuals from similar socio-economic backgrounds who come together to form savings and credit groups.
 
• They play a critical role in empowering rural women and promoting financial inclusion.
 
 
 
• **National Rural Livelihood Mission (NRLM)**:
 
 
• NRLM replaced SGSY in 2011 to provide a more focused and comprehensive approach to rural poverty alleviation.
 
• It emphasizes community-driven approaches and the formation of SHGs.
 
 
 
• **Key Success Factors in Andhra Pradesh:**
 
 
• Effective implementation through strong community institutions.
 
• Active involvement of women in SHGs.
 
• Focus on livelihood diversification and skill development.
